description: Retrieve the Beyond Wine ontology, including entity types, relationship types and semantic scales in JSON or JSON Schema format. Beyond Wine is a published reference for no/low ABV specialty beverages in fine dining, including wine alternatives, craft ferments, kombucha, teas and blends. It excludes non-alcoholic beer, non-alcoholic spirits, mocktails, mixers, dealcoholized wine and blends containing dealcoholized wine. The connection cannot place orders or take payments and cannot guarantee every drink contains absolutely no alcohol.
name: get_ontology
title: Get ontology
